description: We are a team passionate about space science, physics, and geography. We believe exploring space starts with understanding Earth. In the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we chose to locate Earth sites resembling lunar and Martian bases. We aim to use satellite data and geological analysis to help build sustainable space colonies and shape the future of human exploration among the stars.
summary:
Phoenix-A is a simulation and analysis tool for interactive investigations into the fundamental elements of spacecraft mission planning.

Users define their own simulated space mission and investigate various engineering systems such as orbit mechanics, propulsion, power & thermal, deep space communication and mass budgeting.

Interactive inputs, real time calculations and basic graphs allow users to see how varying certain parameters will affect overall mission design.
details:
Phoenix-A is an innovative, interactive web application simulating space missions engineering and systems, serving as a comprehensive preliminary estimation and analysis tool. Phoenix-A connects the theory of orbital mechanics and the science of spacecraft architecture, thus allowing users to design a virtual space mission and explore in real time the engineering subsystems such as orbital mechanics, rocket propulsion, energy and thermal balance, deep space communications, and the overall system mass budgeting.

💻 Tech Stack

- HTML5, Tailwind CSS (from CDN) for modern, responsive, mobile first designs
- JavaScript (ES6 +) for physics engines, SI units formulae and calculations of telemetry
- Chart.js (from CDN) for real-time interactive distribution and performance charts of subsystems
- Version control using Git and live hosting through GitHub pages

🤖 AI Tools Utilized

- ChatGPT
- Gemini

🌟 Innovation Highlights

🌌 Multidestination Orbit Mechanics & Hohmann Transfers: Computes interplanetary Hohmann transfers (Mars, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter) and geocentric lunar transfer to orbit velocities (Δv) and flight times.
⚙️ Cross Subsystems Cascades: Contains real-time cascading calculations, where adjusting parameters in one subsystem will immediately recalculate and update all relevant metrics throughout the whole vehicle design.
📊 Simplified Visualization of Telemetry: Contains real-time dynamic charts and tabular representations of all calculations.
🔬 Automated Physics Validations: Has an internal validation engine performing constant mathematical checks to ensure consistency and validity of engineering.
🌐 Dual Language & Exporting: Full Arabic/English localization, along with instant exporting of mission configuration and report in JSON format.
